text:
Maya: hey all — urgent: got called into a family emergency, need to drop primary for the next ~4 hours. just got paged about a customer-impacting 502 spike on EU-prod. i'm trying to stay on but can’t guarantee response times. can someone pick up primary now? :wave:

incident-bot: Pager triggered (P1): EU-prod ingress 502 spike. Affected customers: two high-traffic tenants. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/eu-ingress-502s. Incident channel: #inc-17555.

Arun: on it. i can take primary for the next 45m, then hand to Sam if needed. i'll start the runbook checklist now. Maya — do you have any context about what you were doing pre-pager?

Maya: thanks, @Arun. nothing special from me, I was running routine deploy earlier (canary finished 30m ago). logs I saw in the alert were 502s coming from ingress -> upstream model-worker health checks failing intermittently.

Jenna: +1 to Arun. I'll shadow for the first hour and keep customer comms open. I can handle the postmortem notes after.

Arun: copying runbook steps here for quick reference:

```
Runbook: EU Ingress 502s
1) Check metrics: dashboards -> eu/ingress/latency / 5m error rate
2) Run quick cURL to origin: curl -sS -I https://eu-ingress.redwood.internal/health
3) Check model-worker pods: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-worker
4) If worker backpressure observed, restart workers on nodes with >80% mem: kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-worker
5) If ingress 502s persist, failover traffic to eu-fallback region via routing policy
6) Open bridge: /zoom inc-17555
```

Arun: running step 2 now.

ops-bot: /zoom inc-17555 -> bridge started: https://zoom.redwood/bridge/inc-17555 (ops bridge open) :telephone_receiver:

Arun: quick check: `curl -sS -I https://eu-ingress.redwood.internal/health` -> 200 ok from my workstation, but edge -> worker path shows 502 in logs. pulling worker logs now:

```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-worker --since=5m | grep -i "503\|502\|error"
```

Arun: seeing repeated `connection reset by peer` from model-worker on nodes gpu-03 and gpu-07. looks like OOM killer or kernel oom? checking node metrics.

Nina: i'm checking node events and saw kubelet OOMKill at 15:12 UTC for model-worker on gpu-07. could be a runaway batch size in one of the queued jobs.

Sam: if those workers are being OOM-killed, we should isolate traffic away from them and scale up a temp pool. I can run the quick autoscale: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=20` then drain the problematic nodes. recommend small step to avoid cache-loss.

Jenna: agree. Arun, can you toggle the routing policy to route new traffic to eu-fallback for ~30m while we stabilize? That lowers customer impact quickly.

Arun: done. routing change applied via console -> routing -> policy eu -> set fallback: true. verifying metrics now.

incident-bot: Routing policy eu updated: fallback to eu-fallback applied by Arun.

Arun: metrics: 502 rate down ~70% after routing change, error rate still a bit noisy — continuing with worker scaling.

Sam: scaling to 20 replicas now. command: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-worker --replicas=20` — started.

Nina: i’ll cordon gpu-07 and gpu-03 and evict pods gracefully once new replicas are ready.

Arun: after scaling and cordon, error rate is trending down. customer-impacted tenants reporting degraded service but no new failures. good to notify CS. Jenna, can you ping CS with current status and ETA ~45m?

Jenna: pinged @CS-team in DM with summary and bridge link, asked them to update customers with "degraded service" and ETA 45m.

Maya: thank you so much all. i'm handing primary to Arun now — Arun will be primary, Jenna will shadow, Sam will be secondary to take over if Arun needs to step out. I'm going offline in 5m.

Arun: taking primary. key next steps logged in the bridge. if anyone is unfamiliar with the runbook steps, call them out now.

Jenna: small note for whoever takes over later: if we need to rollback canary, the command was in deploy playbook: `gcloud run rollouts revert --service=ingress-canary --to-revision=stable-2026-03-14`. Put that in quick links in the incident notes.

Sam: i'll be available at +1 555 0199 if handoff needed. planning to check in at 45m after the scaling completes.

ops-bot: Reminder: please update the incident ticket inc-17555 with actions taken before handing off.

Arun: noted — updating ticket with timeline + runbook steps.

Maya: i'm logging off now, really appreciate you all stepping in. please call me if the bridge escalates. :heart:

Jenna: take care Maya. Arun — assume primary until Sam confirms takeover at ~45m. I'll keep postmortem draft skeleton in the ticket.

Arun: confirmed. handing protocol: before any handoff, ensure error rate <1% for 10m or leave clear note with outstanding actions.

Sam: copy that. will be ready to take primary if error rate resurges or if Arun needs a break.

incident-bot: Incident inc-17555 status: mitigated -> partial (routing applied, scaling in progress). Assigned primary: Arun, secondary: Sam, shadower: Jenna.

Jenna: closing thread here, will add final notes in ticket. great quick coordination, folks.

Sam: thanks team.

(reacts: Maya :ambulance:, Arun :thumbsup:, Jenna :white_check_mark:, Sam :eyes:)
